recent.statement: Aftershock of M5.0 or greater strikes within 100 km of the M6.8 Uto, Japan epicenter
recent.evidence: No admissible signal reports an M5.0+ aftershock near Uto during the window, and an event of that magnitude would have been captured by the seismic feeds.

recent.statement: FOMC will raise interest rates by 50bps at their meeting on July 28th
recent.evidence: No signal reports any FOMC rate decision on July 28, 2026, let alone a 50bps hike; the only FOMC references are future scheduled meetings in October 2026 and January 2027, so a move that significant went unrecorded within the closed window.

recent.statement: VIX will jump to 25 within the next week due to increased equity market turmoil
recent.evidence: No archived signal shows any VIX spike to 25 or equity turmoil during the window, and a volatility surge of that magnitude would have been captured before the window closed.

recent.statement: CBOT corn (ZC=F) settles higher again, closing above 475 ¢/bu
recent.evidence: S1 shows CBOT corn at 473 ¢/bu (+3.16%), higher on the day but below the required 475 ¢/bu close.

recent.statement: Ship transits through the Strait of Hormuz will increase by 20% within the next week
recent.evidence: The current snapshot shows Strait of Hormuz transits at 10 per day, 52% below its 30-day average of 21 — no 20% increase occurred within the window.

recent.statement: Japan Meteorological Agency reports M4.5+ aftershocks near Uto, Kumamoto Prefecture following the M6.8 quake
recent.evidence: The signals only document the M6.8 Uto, Kumamoto earthquake itself (S2, S3); none states that JMA reported M4.5+ aftershocks in the window.

recent.statement: The US dollar will strengthen against the euro by at least 1% in the next week
recent.evidence: No signal reports an actual EUR/USD exchange rate move; S18's headline only notes euro-facing headwinds without stating the dollar gained 1% or more during the window.

recent.statement: At least one aftershock of M5.0 or greater is recorded within 150 km of the M7.1 Uki, Japan epicenter
recent.evidence: None of the admissible signals — including the Wikipedia and Al Jazeera headlines on the M7.1 Kumamoto quake — state that an aftershock of M5.0 or greater occurred within 150 km of the epicenter during the window.

recent.statement: FOMC holds the federal funds target range unchanged at its July 28, 2026 meeting
recent.evidence: No signal confirms the FOMC left the federal funds rate unchanged; signals only confirm the July 28 meeting was scheduled, not its outcome.

recent.statement: The Strait of Hormuz will experience a ship transit increase by at least 20% within the next week
recent.evidence: Strait of Hormuz had 10 daily ship transits, 52% below its 30-day average (21), indicating a decrease, not an increase of at least 20%.
Signal S1 shows Corn (CBOT) at 477 ¢/bu, which is above the 465 ¢/bu threshold stated in the forecast.

recent.statement: Typhoon Noul makes landfall or passes within 100 km of the Guangdong/Pearl River Delta coast, prompting typhoon signals and flight cancellations in Hong Kong or Shenzhen
recent.evidence: No signal explicitly confirms Typhoon Noul made landfall or passed within 100 km of the Pearl River Delta coast, or caused typhoon signals/flights cancellations in Hong Kong/Shenzhen; S3 only mentions an Orange alert for Noul-26 affecting 11.891 million people with Category 1 winds, but does not specify landfall/proximity to the Pearl River Delta or flight cancellations.

self_calibration.note: Published headline probability is RAW conviction (unchanged); this is the honest companion. Calibration fixes overconfidence, not discrimination — see /calibration.
